title: Analytics Engineer II, Full Stack (Revenue Analytics)
description:
Headquarters: Remote Poland

 At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

 We’re looking for a curious, driven professional to join our Revenue Analytics team. This builds and owns the data products, reporting infrastructure, semantic foundations, and analytical systems that power Affirm’s Revenue organization.
As a Senior Analyst, Revenue Analytics, you’ll build scalable data products that power day-to-day decision-making - owning end-to-end work across data modeling, metric definitions, dashboards, automation, and enablement.
You’ll also help strengthen our semantic layer and data governance, laying the foundation for reliable AI. The ideal candidate combines strong technical and analytical skills with the ability to turn ambiguous business questions into durable, well-tested data infrastructure.

 What you'll do

•
 Develop dbt data models, dashboards, metrics, and automation processes for the revenue field team and revenue analysts

•
 Build and maintain critical reporting data models that power external merchant reporting

•
 Build the semantic, metadata, and context layers that allow AI systems to accurately understand Revenue data, metrics, and business definitions

•
 Partner with Business Systems, engineering, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into durable, well-tested data products

•
 Contribute to the team’s best practices in version control, code review, documentation, and release hygiene (GitHub-based workflows)

•
 Develop processes, governance, and foundations to scale the impact of analytics within Revenue.

 What we look for

•
 3+ years of work experience in an analytics engineering or business intelligence role

•
 Strong working knowledge of SQL, dbt, Python, data modeling, and data visualization

•
 Hands-on experience with BI tools (Sigma/Looker/Tableau), Databricks, and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake)

•
 Understanding of the data foundations required for reliable AI, including semantic layers, metadata, evals, metric definitions, documentation, and data quality

•
 Demonstrated experience integrating AI tools into day-to-day analytics engineering workflows to improve development speed, quality, and scalability

•
 Familiarity with Salesforce and experience supporting commercial areas of the business

•
 Ability to identify user needs and translate them into robust, scalable data products

•
 Ability to start with an ambiguous problem, deconstruct it into tangible steps, and work toward an impactful solution

•
 Ability to communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

 Total rewards

 We believe the people building honest financial products at Affirm should share in its success. That's why our total rewards are designed to support your health, growth, financial well-being, and future.

 In service of our mission, we reward employees through a combination of base pay, equity (from parent company), and comprehensive benefits.

 Base Pay Grade - K
 226 000 zł - 346 000 zł

 Base pay ranges and placement within those ranges are determined based on several factors, including role, experience, and job-related skills.

 In addition to base pay, all employees in this role are eligible to receive equity from the parent company each year. This means as Affirm’s parent company grows, employees have the opportunity to share in that growth financially.

 Equity Grade - 2 (awarded in US Dollars)

 Affirm Holdings, Inc. Equity Grade example

 Equity grade: 2
 New hire equity: $16,000-$24,000
 Annual Refresh: $5,000
 Reward equity: $0-$75,000

 Affirm also provides flexible spending wallets to all employees for technology and wellbeing related needs, which are reimbursable up to 1390 zł per month.

 In addition to your compensation, our comprehensive benefits are designed to support you and the people who matter most. Benefits include:

• Competitive paid time off, paid public holidays, and additional paid Away Days to rest and recharge.

• Comprehensive private healthcare through Lux Med's Platinum package.

• A MultiSport card to support your health and well-being.

• Learning and development programs to help you grow professionally.

• Family healthcare support through Maven and parental leave support through Parentaly.

• Mental well-being support through Lyra, including up to 12 confidential counseling or coaching sessions each year for you and your household members.

• Financial well-being support through Northstar, with unlimited access to Certified Financial Advisors and planning tools at no cost to you.

• Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that foster connection and inclusion.

• Eligibility for creative tax benefits, subject to applicable law, role, and company policy.

 Location - Remote Poland

 The majority of our roles can be located anywhere in Poland.

 **This job description is not a contractual document, and is not intended to have binding force.**

 #LI-Remote

 Remote-first with flexibility built in
 Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

 Benefits designed for you
 Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

• Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.

• Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.

• Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.

• Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

 We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

 For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

 By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

title: Senior Staff Data Scientist
description:
Headquarters: Remote

 About the Team:

 Netlify’s Data team helps the company understand and improve the full product-led growth journey, from activation and engagement through conversion, retention, and monetization. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Growth to uncover opportunities, evaluate investments, and understand what drives customer and business outcomes.

 We’re hiring a Senior Staff Data Scientist to deepen how data shapes our product and growth strategy. You’ll develop an end-to-end understanding of the PLG journey, proactively identify opportunities, and turn complex data into hypotheses, experiments, and recommendations that influence where we invest and what we build. This is a highly autonomous role for someone who can move from identifying an important question to shaping the approach, defining success, and driving toward an answer.

 What You'll Do:

• Own the analytical understanding of Netlify’s PLG performance across activation, engagement, conversion, monetization, and retention, identifying opportunities before they become requests

• Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to turn behavioral insights into product bets, defining what to test, how to measure it, and what the results mean

• Lead experimentation from hypothesis through decision, including study design, methodology, success metrics, guardrails, analysis, and recommendations

• Apply statistical rigor where it matters while recognizing when there is enough signal to make a decision and move forward, and help teams develop that same judgment

• Build scalable analytical systems like semantic models, trusted metrics, proactive monitoring, and AI-powered agents that surface opportunities without waiting to be asked

• Use AI to investigate faster, automate recurring analytical work, and test more hypotheses without sacrificing the judgment that makes the output useful

• Identify gaps in measurement, event instrumentation, and metric definitions, and partner with Data and Product Engineering to close them

• Serve as a trusted analytical partner to PLG leadership, using evidence and product judgment to influence investment decisions and roadmap priorities

• Influence product strategy through evidence, product instincts, and a clear point of view, without relying on formal authority to do it

 What You'll Bring:

• 8+ years of experience in product analytics, growth analytics, or data science, with a track record of high ownership and measurable impact on PLG or consumer product outcomes

• Deep understanding of product and growth dynamics across activation, engagement, conversion, monetization, and retention

• Demonstrated ability to turn behavioral data into product hypotheses and carry them from insight through experimentation and measured outcomes

• Deep experimentation expertise: study design, statistical reasoning, causal inference, and the judgment to know when an experiment has told you what you need to know

• Experience building analytical systems such as metrics layers, monitoring frameworks, or semantic models that teams can rely on over time

• An AI-native approach to analysis: you use AI tools actively to accelerate investigation, automate repetitive work, and surface patterns faster

• A track record of influencing senior stakeholders and product direction through analytical reasoning, clear recommendations, and sound judgment

• Comfort operating with significant autonomy in ambiguous problem spaces, including determining which questions are most important to answer

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in distributed environments, with the ability to make complex findings clear and recommendations actionable

 This Role is a Great Fit If:

• You're energized by finding the opportunity before anyone thought to ask - proactive discovery is how you naturally work, not a mode you shift into

• You think like a product person who happens to be exceptionally rigorous with data, not a data person who occasionally weighs in on product

• You thrive when the problem isn't handed to you - you'd rather define the question worth asking than answer the one that landed in your queue

• You get excited about building systems that keep working after you've moved on to the next problem

• You're comfortable making a call with imperfect information and can articulate clearly why you made it

• You enjoy being a thought partner to senior leaders - shaping how they think about investment and opportunity, not just supporting decisions already made

• You work well in a remote-first, async environment where written clarity and self-direction matter more than proximity

• You're drawn to roles where the measure of success is outcomes, decisions made, bets tested, metrics moved, not volume of output produced

 Applying

 Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? Please apply anyway!

 When applying please include:

 A resume or short listing of your job history & skills (link to a LinkedIn profile would be fine). We appreciate a cover letter explaining why you would enjoy working in this role at Netlify to get to know you a bit better, though this is not required and will not impact your application. Our mission is to “build a better web” and that cannot be done without a diversity of skill sets, backgrounds and thoughts.

 Of everything we've ever built at Netlify, we are most proud of our team. Netlify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are devoted to building a team of people with diverse backgrounds and lifestyles. Driving equality empowers our team, enables us to innovate, and helps us maintain a more inclusive environment. We don’t discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, race, military/veteran status, citizenship, pregnancy status, or any other differences. If we can do anything to provide a better interview, i.e. accommodate a disability, then please let us know by emailing accommodations@netlify.com .

 About Netlify

 Netlify is the most popular way to build, deploy, and scale modern web applications, empowering everyone from fast moving solo developers to enterprise teams. Millions of developers and organizations rely on Netlify as their platform of choice for composing web applications that are production ready, performant, and flexible. Now, as we embrace the next era of software development, we are embedding the same fluid, intuitive experience into the Agent Experience (AX), making it just as simple for intelligent agents to understand, interact with, and act on our platform as it is for developers. Whether your user is human or machine, Netlify ensures the path from idea to URL is seamless, fast, and deeply reliable.

 We are a Series D company that has raised over $200M from investors such as Andreessen Horowitz, Kleiner Perkins, EQT, Bessemer, BOND, and Menlo Ventures. title: Business Continuity Management Lead
description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States

 About the Role

 Mercury is seeking a Business Continuity Management (BCM) Lead to build and lead an enterprise-wide continuity program as we prepare to become a bank. As part of the Risk team, this leader will establish practical standards, clear accountability, and tested capabilities to maintain critical services and recover effectively from disruptions, with direct visibility to the CRO and senior leadership.

 This role fills the need for a dedicated leader to coordinate BCM across the organization. The ideal candidate combines deep continuity and resilience expertise with the judgment to build a proportionate program in a fast-moving environment, working effectively with Engineering, Operations, Product, Information Security, Legal, Compliance, and business teams.

 The BCM Lead will own the enterprise framework, coordination, oversight, and reporting. Business and technology owners will remain accountable for their continuity plans and recovery execution.Because this is a new program, the Lead will be hands-on in the initial build: facilitating the first round of BIAs and plans side by side with owners, running exercises, and driving identified gaps through remediation. This leader will also work closely with Engineering on technology disaster recovery and with relevant teams on incident response, crisis management, and third-party resilience.

 Key Responsibilities

• Develop and implement Mercury’s enterprise BCM framework, policies, standards, governance, and operating model, with a prioritized implementation roadmap aligned to bank-launch readiness and critical services.

• Partner with business owners to identify critical services, conduct business impact analyses (customer, financial, operational, and regulatory), and map dependencies across people, processes, technology, facilities, and third parties, including single points of failure.

• Establish recovery time objectives (RTOs) and recovery point objectives (RPOs), where applicable, with business and technology owners; challenge gaps between objectives and recovery capabilities.

• Set standards for continuity plans and recovery procedures, and facilitate and support accountable owners in developing actionable plans and alternative operating arrangements.

• Coordinate business continuity with technology disaster recovery, incident response, and crisis management, with clear activation criteria, escalation paths, and communications responsibilities.

• Design and lead a risk-based exercise program, from tabletop simulations to end-to-end recovery tests, and drive lessons learned, remediation tracking, and verification that gaps are closed.

• Partner with Third-Party Risk Management and vendor owners to assess critical provider recovery capabilities, contingency arrangements, and concentration dependencies.

• Embed continuity considerations into new products, material business changes, and technology implementations.

• Establish metrics and reporting that give management and relevant committees visibility into readiness, testing outcomes, material gaps, and overdue remediation.

• Build and lead a growing BCM team, including hiring and developing analysts as the program scales over the next year.

• Deliver role-based training and promote awareness of continuity responsibilities across the organization.

• Support regulatory examinations and bank-launch readiness reviews with accurate documentation and evidence of recovery capability.

 Qualifications

• 10+ years of experience in business continuity management, operational resilience, disaster recovery, or a related discipline within a fintech, financial institution, technology company, or other highly regulated environment.

• Demonstrated experience building or materially enhancing an enterprise BCM program, including governance, implementation, testing, and reporting.

• Strong skills in business impact analysis, critical-service identification, dependency mapping, and recovery objective development.

• Experience developing actionable continuity plans and leading exercises that test recovery assumptions and expose gaps.

• Sufficient technical fluency to work with Engineering on cloud services, system dependencies, data recovery, and technology disaster recovery.

• Working knowledge of third-party risk management, including assessing critical vendor recovery capabilities, contingency arrangements and concentration risk.

• Proven ability to drive cross-functional remediation through influence, with a clear view of where BCM oversight ends and business or technology ownership begins.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain readiness gaps and tradeoffs to senior leadership.

• Experience managing a team of Business Continuity analysts.

 Preferred Qualifications

• Familiarity with banking supervisory expectations for business continuity, and operational resilience.

• Experience operating in a company-building or bank-building environment.

• Familiarity with recognized continuity standards, such as ISO 22301, and BCM tools for plan management, exercises, and issue tracking.

• Relevant professional certification, such as CBCP or MBCI.

 Leadership Attributes

• Pragmatic, first-principles builder who turns ambiguous needs into clear priorities and designs a program that fits Mercury’s operations and scale.

• Takes ownership and follows through from identified gaps to demonstrated recovery.

• Collaborative, low-ego, and effective across the three lines of defense.

• Calm under pressure and able to facilitate clear decisions during disruptions.

• Able to challenge constructively, distinguish material gaps from theoretical concerns, and avoid over-engineering.

 *Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

 Mercury values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. title: Analytics Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote - United States

 Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

 We are looking for a talented and driven individual to be a key part of our Analytics Engineering team within the Data Science organization. We are looking for someone who can work closely with Data Scientists and Engineers across diverse areas of the organization (Consumer, Ads, and Marketing) to curate, develop, and deploy the right data and analytic tooling to drive Reddit’s product forward and provide a data and tooling foundation that will last decades. Your work will empower thousands of your colleagues to improve the user experience and grow our consumer base.

 Successful candidates have a strong track record of understanding and deeply caring about the purpose of data to support business goals, and can act as an effective conduit between Data Producers and Data Consumers. This role sits at the intersection of Data Science and Data Engineering, and the ideal candidate has skills, experience, and passion in both areas.

 Responsibilities:

• Be a key contributor and collaborator to the success of data quality, performance, reliability, and automation initiatives.

• Manage a portfolio of data products that deliver high-quality, trustworthy data

• Develop and maintain robust data pipelines and workflows for data ingestion, processing, and transformation. Work closely with engineering to ensure the quality and reliability of these data pipelines.

• Develop and implement data quality checks, conduct QA and implement monitoring routines

• Create and manage new data integrations across internal and external systems

• Create tools and applications for internal use that streamline data analysis and reporting. Drive widespread adoption of these tools and applications with a relentless focus on automation, consistency, and reliability.

• Serve as a thought partner for data scientists, engineering managers, and leadership on data foundations, communicating and shaping the data foundations roadmap and strategy for Reddit.

 Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in computer science or a quant educational field

• 3+ years of experience working with large-scale ETL systems (implementation, strategy, and maintenance), building clean, maintainable code and systems (Python preferred) in a production environment.

• Strong programming proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark, Scala, etc.

• Experience with data modeling, ETL and ELT concepts, and patterns for efficient data governance. Experience with manipulating massive-scale structured and unstructured data.

• Experience with data workflows (such as Airflow), data modeling, front-end or back-end engineering.

• Experience in data analysis and dashboard design.

• Deep understanding of technical and functional designs for relational and MPP Databases.

• Proven track record of cross-functional execution and collaboration.

• Agentic AI-assisted development experience.

• Excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders at all levels of the company, of differing levels of technical acumen.

• Self-starter, ability to work independently and autonomously, as well as part of a team.

 Check out our r/RedditEng post to learn more about the team, and what we do: https://www.reddit.com/r/RedditEng/comments/1mnmf71/analytics_engineering_reddit/

title: Freelance Marketo Email Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote (US)

 About the Role

 As a Freelance Marketo Email Specialist, you'll build, test, and launch email programs in Marketo for a range of client brands. This is a hands-on, execution-only contract role with no leadership or management responsibilities. You'll take approved briefs and turn them into working programs, building responsive templates and modules, setting up smart lists and flows, and making sure every send goes out right the first time. You know Marketo well enough to spot a broken token, a misfired trigger, or a segmentation gap before it reaches a subscriber. You'll take direction from our internal team, get up to speed fast, and deliver accurate builds on schedule with minimal oversight.

 Key Responsibilities

• Build and launch email programs in Marketo, including one-off sends, nurture streams, engagement programs, and triggered campaigns.

• Develop and maintain responsive email templates and modular components in HTML and CSS, using Marketo's template syntax, variables, and editable sections.

• Set up smart lists, smart campaigns, flow steps, and segmentations that match the targeting and logic in the brief.

• Use tokens, dynamic content, and snippets to personalize emails and keep programs easy to clone and reuse.

• QA every email before launch: rendering across clients and devices (e.g. Litmus or Email on Acid), links, tokens, personalization fallbacks, and list logic.

• Manage program structure, naming conventions, and folder organization so client instances stay clean and easy to navigate.

• Build to the brief and requirements provided, and flag any gaps or errors in the request before they become problems in the send.

• Communicate status, timelines, and blockers clearly with your internal point of contact.

• Document builds and processes so other team members can pick up, update, or reuse the work.

• Follow established Marketo, deliverability, and accessibility standards on every build.

 Qualifications

 Required

• At least 3 years of hands-on experience building and deploying email campaigns in Marketo Engage.

• Strong working knowledge of Marketo programs, smart lists, smart campaigns, tokens, snippets, and dynamic content.

• Proficiency in HTML and CSS for email, including responsive and hybrid coding and Marketo template syntax.

• Experience with email rendering and QA tools such as Litmus or Email on Acid.

• A detail-oriented QA process that catches errors in logic, links, and personalization before launch.

• Experience working across multiple clients or Marketo instances, adapting quickly to different setups and conventions.

• Clear, proactive communication, including flagging risks early and giving accurate time estimates.

• Ability to work independently, take direction well, and hit deadlines across overlapping requests.

 Preferred

• Marketo Certified Expert or Marketo Certified Associate.

• Familiarity with email deliverability, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and list hygiene.

• Experience with email accessibility standards (e.g. WCAG).

• Experience with lead scoring, lifecycle programs, and Marketo–Salesforce CRM sync.

• Experience with other marketing automation platforms (e.g. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, Braze).

• Agency or consulting experience.

 Why Current

 At Current, we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact.

 We're a remote-first agency with teams across the US, working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex technical challenges alongside smart, supportive teammates.

 You'll have the opportunity to work across a variety of clients and technologies, and contribute to meaningful digital experiences within a growing agency environment.

 This is a freelance, contract engagement. The target hourly rate for this role is $50 - $70 per hour. Actual rate is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.

title: Senior Data Scientist, Artist-First AI Music lab
description:
The Music Mission team owns Spotify's end to end proposition for music creators and the experiences they create for fans. The team is dedicated to building tools and services to enable creation, promotion, expression, and monetization at scale.
We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join the Artist-First AI Music lab. Our team explores and advances generative technologies for music to create new experiences for fans and artists, with a focus on listening experiences that center and celebrate artists and creatives. All of our products will put artists and songwriters first, through these four principles:
Partnerships with record labels, distributors, and music publishers: We'll develop new products for artists and fans through upfront agreements, not by asking for forgiveness later.
Choice in participation: We recognize there's a wide range of views on use of generative music tools within the artistic community. Therefore, artists and rightsholders will choose if and how to participate to ensure the use of AI tools aligns with the values of the people behind the music.
Fair compensation and new revenue: We will build products that create wholly new revenue streams for rightsholders, artists, and songwriters, ensuring they are properly compensated for uses of their work and transparently credited for their contributions.
Artist-fan connection: AI tools we develop will not replace human artistry. They will give artists new ways to be creative and connect with fans. We will use our role as the place where more than 700 million people already come to listen to music every month to ensure that generative AI deepens artist-fan connections.
For more information, see this press release: https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-10-16/artist-first-ai-music-spotify-collaboration/

title: Full Stack Engineer - Music
description:
Music Expression builds the tools artists use to show who they are on Spotify and to connect with fans. A song doesn't have to be just a track in a list. On Spotify it can come with a looping Canvas visual, a music video, a vertical-video clip from the artist, or a countdown to a new release. Release day can become a shared Listening Party. title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote

 URL: https://www.samsara.com/

 About the role:

 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world. The platform processes 25+ trillion data points annually from IoT sensors, cameras, and connected devices across thousands of organizations, and that dataset is compounding: it grew from 4 trillion to 25+ trillion in four years. We're still early in turning that data into the products that will define how physical operations run, and we're hiring the engineers who will build what comes next.

 We're approaching ~$2B ARR growing 30%+ year over year, with 96% of our largest customers on two or more products. The fastest-growing divisions at Samsara are tackling the hardest, most ambiguous problems at the company: building new products from scratch, applying AI and ML to massive real-world datasets, and shipping capabilities that change how organizations maintain equipment, manage fleets, and run day-to-day operations. Most of this work is zero-to-one, at billion-dollar scale.

 We're looking for software engineers who want to define what ships next. Leveling is broad and flexible: we're hiring from Senior through Staff+, across platform and product, and we're open to shaping scope around the right person's strengths and interests. That window won't stay open long.

 This role is remote and open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

 You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will have real-world stakes: helping keep the lights on, getting food into grocery stores, keeping workers safe. What ships here isn't metrics on a dashboard. It shows up on the loading dock, the job site, and the dispatch floor.

• You want to build, not maintain. Samsara is in full growth mode. We're building new systems from scratch, not babysitting old ones. You'd own entire problem spaces end to end, with the autonomy to set direction from day one.

• You want to work where AI meets the physical world. Samsara has spent a decade building the largest proprietary dataset for physical operations. More connected assets generate more data, more data trains better models, better models drive more value, and more value wins more assets. The market and the opportunity here are what set us apart, not just the models.

• You believe customers are more than a number. Samsara engineers have a rare closeness to end users. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with product managers and customer success, and use that context to build products that solve real problems operators face every day.

• You have the curiosity and drive to figure it out. We're looking for people who take pride in their work and get things done at all costs. The engineers who thrive here don't wait to be told what to build. They define it, ship it, and own the outcome. The rate-limiting step on our teams isn't tooling or process. It's ambition.

 In this role, you will:

• Take ownership of technically complex, mission-critical areas and run with them. We want to point you in a direction and show up to the demo meeting impressed, not spend our weeks managing the details.

• Define and drive technical strategy for new products and platform capabilities, from backend services and APIs to the customer-facing UI.

• Design and ship full-stack features end to end. You'll work across backend, frontend, and potentially mobile to deliver AI-powered products that solve real operational problems.

• Partner with product, design, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous, real-world problems into clear technical plans and measurable outcomes.

• Build and scale the systems behind AI-driven products, including data ingestion, APIs, and the workflows that put intelligence into the hands of operators.

• Raise the bar for the engineers around you through code reviews, design reviews, technical mentorship, and by setting a standard for quality, velocity, and craft.

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

 Minimum requirements for the role:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

• 8+ years of experience in software design and development, including building and operating production systems at scale.

• Strong full-stack fundamentals. You're comfortable working across backend services, APIs, and frontend (web or mobile) to ship complete products.

• Proficiency in modern languages and frameworks (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, or similar).

• Demonstrated experience leading cross-team or cross-org projects from inception through rollout, including managing ambiguity, driving alignment, and delivering measurable impact.

• Experience building AI-powered or data-driven products. You don't need to train models, but you know how to take AI capabilities and turn them into products customers love.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• A track record of building: zero-to-one products, systems you left in a meaningfully better place, or hard problems you refused to let stay unsolved.

 An ideal candidate also has:

• Experience shipping AI-powered features in production, whether that's LLM-based products, agentic workflows, recommendation systems, or other customer-facing AI.

• Comfort with modern AI-augmented development workflows (Cursor, LLMs, etc.) to multiply your output and accelerate delivery.

• Background working with real-world operational data (telematics, sensor data, work orders, inspections) or a strong interest in learning the domain.

• A proven track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing engineering culture, standards, and best practices beyond a single team.

• Side projects, open-source contributions, or other signals of curiosity and drive outside the scope of your day job.

 The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

 Annual Base Salary

 $162,400 — $290,000 USD

 Total Rewards

 At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

 Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

 Flexible Working

 At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

 Belonging at Samsara

 At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/samsara-staff-software-engineer

title: Research Scientist - Generative Audio
description:
We are seeking Research Scientists (across all levels of seniority) to join our Artist-First AI Music Lab. Our team pioneers and advances state-of-the-art generative technologies for music that create breakthrough experiences for fans and artists. We invent entirely new listening experiences that center and celebrate artists and creatives. All of our products will put artists and songwriters first, through these four principles:
Partnerships with record labels, distributors, and music publishers: We’ll develop new products for artists and fans through upfront agreements, not by asking for forgiveness later.
Choice in participation: We recognize there’s a wide range of views on the use of generative music tools within the artistic community. Therefore, artists and rightsholders will choose if and how to participate to ensure the use of AI tools aligns with the values of the people behind the music.
Fair compensation and new revenue: We will build products that create wholly new revenue streams for rightsholders, artists, and songwriters, ensuring they are properly compensated for the use of their work and transparently credited for their contributions.
Artist-fan connection: AI tools we develop will not replace human artistry. They will give artists new ways to be creative and connect with fans. We will leverage our role as the place where more than 700 million people already come to listen to music every month to ensure that generative AI deepens artist-fan connections.
Learn more in our press release: https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-10-16/artist-first-ai-music-spotify-collaboration/

title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer - US Government - Federal Health and Civilian
description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


The Role
 
Palantir powers mission-critical work across federal health and civilian agencies - from improving patient care and accelerating public health responses, to helping farmers access services, modernizing tax record reviews, and improving aviation safety.

Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) work directly with customers to rapidly understand their hardest problems and build solutions against them. Projects often start with an open-ended question: "How do we respond to a foodborne illness outbreak faster?" or "Where is our medical supply chain failing patients?" Your job is to show up and solve them.

In Federal Health/Civil, your responsibilities look like those of a startup CTO. You'll own end-to-end execution of high-stakes projects within small, high-ownership teams, spanning the full stack of execution: whiteboarding architecture with engineers, building data pipelines and operational workflows, deploying AI agents, advising customer executives, and driving strategy with your team - sometimes all in the same day.

Whether you want to be an entrepreneur or an engineering leader, Palantir is built to get you there. You'll learn to unpack ambiguous problems and reason carefully about the cost and consequence of solutions. You'll work autonomously, make consequential decisions, and build with some of the country's most important institutions - with colleagues who will support and challenge you along the way.

title: Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer - Content Platform
description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
The Content Platform team powers the full lifecycle of content across music, podcasts, audiobooks, and emerging formats at Spotify. We ensure that everything from licensed catalog to user-generated content is understood, trusted, safe, and high quality for millions of listeners worldwide. Our systems are responsible for how content is ingested, understood, enriched, governed, and distributed across the platform.
As the scale and diversity of content continue to grow—driven by advances in AI, new creation tools, and emerging content formats—we’re investing in intelligent systems that can understand, evaluate, manage, and route content reliably at global scale.
We’re hiring Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineers to build and scale foundational ML systems that power content understanding, safety, policy enforcement, and decisioning across Spotify. Depending on your experience and interests, you may focus on areas ranging from multimodal content understanding and platform-level ML systems to safety, risk detection, policy enforcement, and compliance.
You’ll help shape the architecture and technical strategy behind how Spotify understands and makes decisions about content at global scale. This work is foundational to delivering safe, high-quality experiences for listeners and creators while enabling new ways for people to interact with content across Spotify.

Your approach is hands-on and pragmatic: you’ll rapidly address issues as they arise with quick and effective solutions, and advocate for workflow or product improvements once the immediate issue is resolved. You don’t just fix issues — you look for opportunities to simplify, automate, and make the entire system more resilient.

You may have deep experience in one area—such as endpoint security, Active Directory, Data Loss Prevention, cloud security, identity, or detection and response—but you’re motivated by solving security problems across the environment.

As an Information Security Engineer focused on infrastructure security, you'll help protect Palantir's global endpoints, servers, identity systems, applications, networks, and data flows. Fellows will join alongside full-time Palantirians, supplemented with programming curated to fuel growth and criticality. Fellowships will begin October 2026. As an FDSE, you’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organizations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to some of the world’s most important industries and institutions.
 
This role is based in our New York City office and is open to students and recent graduates of the French Grandes Écoles.

As an FDSE Intern, your responsibilities look similar to those at a small startup, with the resources, stability and mentorship of an established tech company: You’ll work in small teams with minimal supervision and own end-to-end execution of high stakes projects. Your day might span discussing architecture with fellow engineers, wrangling massive-scale data, coding a custom web app, speaking with customer executives, or establishing strategy for your team.
 
FDSE Interns are treated just like full time engineers, with significant freedom and ownership over their work. Interns take responsibility for real world projects and outcomes that our customers rely on.

You'll be held to the same performance standards as any Palantir engineer, and your career progression will be based purely on merit and impact.
 
We move fast. We expect excellence. We don't require you to sit still.

title: Meritocracy Fellowship
description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.
 
The Program
 
We believe meritocracy is the operating system for execution: find ability wherever it exists, give people room to act, and judge them by the quality of what they do.

The American university once advanced this vision extraordinarily well. At its best, it found talented individuals from every background, exposed them to challenging ideas, and sent them into the world sharper, more capable, and imbued with purpose. When it worked, it was extraordinary.

Yet in recent decades, many of our finest institutions strayed from this calling. Admissions committees elevated other priorities. Classrooms rewarded conformity over honesty and rigor. Credentials replaced true capability. Cost became decoupled from value.

We launched the Meritocracy Fellowship to recover that highest purpose: find exceptionally talented individuals, forge them intellectually, give them responsibility, and judge them by their achievements alone. Based purely on merit and academic excellence, graduating high school students will be invited to interview, and select applicants will receive a Meritocracy Fellowship. Those that excel will obtain offers to join Palantir full time.

Skip the debt. Get the real education. Earn the Palantir degree.
 
The Curriculum
 
For five weeks, Fellows grapple with the ideas that shape our civilization. What is the West? Is it worth defending? In what ways is America exceptional within this broader context? And what is Palantir's mission in that context?

Fellows read great works, visit institutions at the frontiers of knowledge and public life, and work alongside one another to build something real. This is the education that universities were designed to deliver: rigorous, Socratic, grounded in the texts and ideas that actually matter. Not a lecture hall. Not a curriculum designed by committee. A room full of people who are smarter than you, expecting you to hold your own.

This initial period lays the intellectual foundation before Fellows join forward-deployed engineering or internal software teams. Fellows spend substantial time building in the first five weeks and learn from Palantirians working across engineering, product, security, deployment, and operations.

Our most vital technologies cannot be created by those indifferent to their purpose. Today's challenges demand builders who are guided by conviction and a clear sense of mission.
 
The Role
 
Once Fellows join Palantir's development or forward deployed engineering teams, they are treated like any other Palantir software engineer: joining a team and working alongside customers onsite.

Fellows are not given internship projects; they are given the responsibility of a full-time engineer. They learn the problem from the people who live it, build against real data, ship software, and iterate. The data is real. The stakes are real. The people depending on the outcome are real.

In this role, the challenges you'll seek will require a curious and analytical approach, a sharp intuition for product, and a strong degree of user insight. You will be matched to roles based on your skills, interests, and experience.

The only factor that determines whether you advance here is outcomes.

A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Palantir Design Team is responsible for the human experience of using our software. Our team is growing rapidly, but we're committed to creating a tight-knit team environment that fosters trust, integrity, empathy, and growth. We work together in realizing a shared product vision, and regularly give feedback and critique to each other.
 
Designing at Palantir is a varied experience. On a given day, you might be: leading a design sprint for your product team; designing a micro-interaction to make a complex analytical task feel simple; and/or advocating for UX consistency by creating flexible, reusable UI components.
 
Core Responsibilities
 
• Interaction and visual design. As a product designer, you'll be involved at every stage of design work. You'll help define early product concepts, flesh out the high-level workflow and micro-interactions of a feature, and execute on a crisp and effective visual design. You should have experience with some of the following mockup and prototyping tools: Sketch, Framer, Principle, Figma, Invision.
• User research. We frequently do informal user research, and value people who can be flexible with research processes and methodologies to achieve the right outcome. You'll often visit customer offices to interview and learn from the users we serve. You'll pair qualitative methods (e.g. scripted usability tests and contextual inquiry) with quantitative information, like product and usage metrics.
• Prototyping. You will prototype—using software like Principle and Framer, or another favorite method—both to communicate your designs and validate your decisions.
• Partnering with engineers. We work closely with product and forward deployed engineers to realize our design ideas. You'll treat engineers as partners and collaborate with them to prototype and build out products.
• Awareness of how software interfaces are built. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, Javascript, and Typescript is appreciated. You don't need to be an expert—just fluent enough to collaborate with engineers, and know what's possible with frontend technologies. Resources and mentorship are available to designers who want to learn more.
 
Designers at Palantir have great autonomy over their work, so a wide skill set is necessary. However, many designers on the team are also passionate experts in one area. You might be the kind of designer who ships code every week, or the kind of designer who shares detailed user research findings with your team.

The Role

We pioneered this unique position, embedding engineers directly with our customers to tackle their most pressing challenges head-on. As an FDE, you’ll be at the intersection of world-changing problems and impactful technology, shaping solutions where they matter most.

From hospital beds to factory floors, Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) embed themselves in the customer’s reality until the problem is theirs. This requires walking many miles in a customer’s shoes, building past the perimeter of what the product currently offers, and deviating from every pre-existing formula to solve the problem. Whether that problem is “How do we predict and mitigate wildfire risks across a power grid?” or “How can we analyze and adapt a global supply chain to deliver critical parts on time?”, you’ll use your technical expertise, creativity, and problem-solving skills to drive real-world impact.
 
Core Responsibilities
 
To solve mission-critical problems by deploying software and AI into the high stakes operations of the world’s leading institutions. This requires a ruthless commitment to truth-seeking and prioritizing real outcomes. 

The work is difficult. The stakes are real. You will work in small, high-trust teams and own projects end-to-end, from the first conversation with a customer, to shipping the product that changes how they operate. You will embed with the customer, the chaos, and the consequences, and will be entrusted with real ownership to: 
Collaborate with engineers to make architecture and design decisions
Wrestle with data at a scale that breaks assumptions and demands invention
Build custom applications, LLM workflows, and production solutions engineered for a specific customer's reality

You will work to accommodate all aspects of an environment to drive real technical outcomes for our customers.
 
Whether you aspire to be an entrepreneur or an engineering leader, we believe Palantir is the best place — with the best colleagues — to learn how. You’ll learn how to unpack a problem and understand the costs and consequences of its solution. You’ll learn new technologies and languages, and even develop them yourself. You’ll work autonomously and make decisions independently, within a community that will support and challenge you as you grow and develop.

title: Privacy and Civil Liberties Software Engineer, Internship
description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


The Role
 
The Privacy and Civil Liberties (PCL) Engineering team is a interdisciplinary team of software engineers, forward-deployed engineers, designers, lawyers, and policy experts. The first of its kind in the tech industry, Palantir’s PCL team was formed 15+ years ago as a rejection of the prevailing view that privacy protections must be sacrificed to national security interest. Today, the mission of the PCL team goes far beyond civil liberties protections, and our work challenges other false tradeoffs between operational effectiveness and the defining values of our society: Effective military operations should not be at odds with protecting civilians and upholding the Law of Armed Conflict. Deploying AI with scale and speed should never compromise safety, reliability, and governance. The PCL team builds software and forward deploys to ensure that our customers can pursue their hardest operational challenges while keeping ethical imperatives in plain sight. You can read more about the team on the Palantir blog here.

As a PCL Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and developing full-stack software products for privacy, data protection, AI governance, and accountability in Palantir’s software platforms. You may build security and governance primitives in our platform, applications for auditors, user-facing workflows for AI governance, internal tools for data protection, or something new all-together to help our customers address their next set of challenges. In every case, the software that you build will directly help our customers both carry out their missions more effectively and better meet their legal and ethical obligations. As part of this role, your efforts will be informed by collaborations with technical and non-technical teammates to understand our customers’ key challenges. Your technical approaches will entail engaging with and even helping to shape the latest developments in law and policy. 

The skills and background of successful candidates may vary highly, but curiosity, grit, and a drive to run toward hard socio-technical problems are critical for our team. We’re looking for engineers who are passionate about addressing real-world challenges and empowering our customers to carry out their workflows both effectively and responsibly.

Designing at Palantir is a varied experience. On a given day, you might be: leading a design sprint for your product team; designing a micro-interaction to make a complex analytical task feel simple; and/or advocating for UX consistency by creating flexible, reusable UI components.
 
You consider things like API documentation, SDK functionality, and developer onboarding and can speak the language of a developer. You have familiarity with existing developer tooling and have strong understanding of developer workflows. 
 
Core Responsibilities
 
• Interaction and visual design. As a product designer, you'll be involved at every stage of design work. You'll help define early product concepts, flesh out the high-level workflow and micro-interactions of a feature, and execute on a crisp and effective visual design. You should have experience with mockup and prototyping tools.
• User research. We frequently do informal user research, and value people who can be flexible with research processes and methodologies to achieve the right outcome.
• Prototyping. You will prototype, both to communicate your designs and validate your decisions.
• Partnering with engineers. We work closely with product and forward deployed engineers to realize our design ideas. You'll treat engineers as partners and collaborate with them to prototype and build out products.
• Awareness of how software interfaces are built. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, Javascript, and Typescript is appreciated. You don't need to be an expert—just fluent enough to collaborate with engineers, and know what's possible with frontend technologies. Resources and mentorship are available to designers who want to learn more.
 
Designers at Palantir have great autonomy over their work, so a wide skill set is necessary. However, many designers on the team are also passionate experts in one area. You might be the kind of designer who ships code every week, or the kind of designer who shares detailed user research findings with your team.

title: Principal Product Manager
description:
The Opportunity

As Principal Product Manager, you'll own the vision, product strategy and roadmap for our product portfolio across physical, digital and blended learning experiences.

You'll work closely with senior employees across Product, Technology, Learning, Commercial, Marketing, Sales and Customer Experience to ensure we're focused on the opportunities that deliver the greatest value for our customers, learners and business.

This role is about far more than roadmap delivery.

You'll influence strategic investment choices, elevate product management capability across the organisation, help shape our approach to AI and emerging technologies, and build the frameworks, governance and operating rhythms that enable high-performing product teams to thrive.

You'll also play a key role in developing product management capability across Insights, helping to establish the standards, frameworks and ways of working that enable teams to deliver exceptional outcomes.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Defining and delivering the product vision, strategy and multi-year roadmap for our learner product portfolio.
  • Steering product investment and prioritisation choices across a diverse product landscape.
  • Identifying opportunities to innovate, scale, simplify or retire products.
  • Driving measurable improvements in customer, learner and commercial outcomes.
  • Partnering with Product, Technology, Learning and Design teams to bring innovative ideas to market.
  • Using insight, data and evidence to inform product choices and portfolio direction.
  • Coaching and developing Product Managers while contributing to product leadership across the organisation.
  • Influencing senior stakeholders and helping shape wider business product strategy.
  • Exploring how emerging technologies, including AI, can enhance product experiences and business value.

What We're Looking For

We're interested in hearing from experienced product evangelists who have successfully shaped product strategy, influenced investment outcomes and led teams, portfolios or product functions in complex organisations.

Your background may come from SaaS, technology, professional services, learning, HR technology, consultancy or another environment where you've delivered meaningful customer and commercial outcomes. What's most important is your ability to think strategically, make evidence-based conclusions and bring people together around a shared product vision.

What matters most is your ability to demonstrate:

  • Experience managing complex product portfolios or multiple interconnected products.
  • A track record of creating and executing product strategies linked to measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong commercial acumen and experience making investment and prioritisation choices.
  • Experience managing and developing high-performing product teams.
  • Confidence influencing senior stakeholders across complex organisations.
  • Strong technology fluency and an understanding of modern product development approaches.
  • The ability to balance strategic thinking with pragmatic delivery.
  • An evidence-led approach to decision making.

Experience within SaaS, HR Technology, Learning Technology, Professional Services, Digital Products or Product Transformation environments would be particularly valuable, although not essential.

Why Join Insights?

This is an opportunity to:

  • Shape a global portfolio of learning products that help organisations unlock the potential of their people.
  • Influence strategic investment and product choices at organisational level.
  • Play a visible senior role within Product & Innovation.
  • Help define the future of learning experiences through technology, innovation and AI.
  • Work within a values-led organisation committed to growth, curiosity and continuous learning.
  • Join a business where people genuinely care about making a positive impact.

Benefits:

• 37 days holidays

• Discretionary Annual Bonus

• Private Medical Insurance

• Income Protection
• Pension Plan
• Health Cash Plan
• Life Assurance
• Electric Car Scheme
• Gymflex
• Employee Giving
• My Advantage – Employee Discounts
• Critical Illness cover
• Employee Assistance Program
• Holiday purchase option

• Flexible working

Everyone is welcome at Insights. We’re dedicated to creating a space where you belong — that means accepting you for who you are now and supporting you on your journey towards whoever you want to become.

Our colourful solutions help people see themselves and others in a new light and we love encouraging our diverse global community to experience the transformational power of Insights Discovery. Through listening and learning, we will continue to foster the connections that matter to build a more inclusive culture.

It is in our nature to nurture. We have developed an organisation which puts care for our people, inclusion, belonging and wellbeing at the heart of our approach. We’re strengthened by a community where we work together to co-create a culture that celebrates difference and welcomes everybody.

We love learning. We want to be better tomorrow than we are today and we’re up for the journey. Unapologetically human, undoubtedly individual. Colourful to our core.

Read more about inclusivity at Insights via the vacancy page on our website:

Help shape the next generation of product and learning experiences at one of the world's leading people development organisations.

At Insights, we believe people thrive when they better understand themselves and others. Our learning solutions help organisations across the globe build stronger relationships, develop leaders and create lasting positive change.

We're now looking for a Principal Product Manager to join our Product Leadership Team and play a key role in shaping the future of our product portfolio.

This is a rare opportunity to influence the product strategy, performance and evolution of a global portfolio of learning products and experiences used by organisations around the world. Reporting directly to our Head of Product, you'll play a key role in determining where we invest, what we evolve, what we scale and where we innovate next.

If you're an experienced product leader who enjoys operating at the intersection of customer value, commercial outcomes and innovation, we'd love to hear from you.

This role offers the opportunity to shape strategic investment outcomes, influence organisational priorities and leave a lasting impact on how products are developed and delivered across Insights.

Flexible Working

We believe people do their best work when they can balance their professional and personal commitments. That's why we're open to discussing flexible working arrangements and will consider requests that help you thrive both at work and at home. If there's something we can do to support you, please let us know.

title: Director of Engineering Productivity and Operations
description:
Are you ready to shape the future of data?

Matillion is the company behind Maia, the AI Data Automation platform.

In the AI economy, demand for data is exploding. Manual data engineering can’t keep up. Maia fixes that by combining 15 years of data expertise with agentic AI to eliminate the manual work that slows data teams down. Organisations like Cisco, DocuSign, and Slack are already using it to deliver real business impact, faster.

We started in Manchester and now we’re global - with teams across the UK, US and India.

We are driven, curious, energetic people who move fast, think big and hold ourselves to a high standard. We’re here to make a dent in the universe bigger than ourselves. And we’re looking for people who want to be part of it.

About the Role

We're looking for a Director of Engineering Productivity & Operations to lead how our engineering organisation builds, delivers and operates the Maia platform. You'll own the strategy and execution behind our engineering productivity agenda, including the evolution of our software development lifecycle towards an increasingly agentic model, alongside the operational disciplines that keep engineering efficient: metrics, reporting, cloud and tooling spend, and vendor management. Working closely with engineering leaders across the business and with Finance, you'll lead a team spanning developer experience, release engineering and CloudOps, and have real scope to shape the role and make it your own.

What you will be doing

  • Setting and leading the engineering productivity strategy, driving the move towards an agentic software delivery model across planning, coding, testing, review and deployment.

  • Owning the roadmap for shared engineering platforms and delivery capabilities, including CI/CD, release automation, observability and the developer experience.

  • Running the engineering operating rhythm and a trusted metrics framework, giving leadership clear visibility of delivery, quality, reliability and cost.

  • Leading engineering FinOps and cloud cost optimisation, working with your CloudOps analysts to build forecasting, accountability and sustainable savings.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description:
Deputy is a global SaaS workforce management company with hubs in Sydney, Melbourne, San Francisco and London, plus team members working remotely across the United States. Our platform serves over 1.5 million workers and 375,000 workplaces across 100+ countries. We are backed by top global investors and recently achieved Unicorn status.
At Deputy, we’re improving the world of work, one shift at a time, for 80% of the world’s workforce: hourly workers. These are the dedicated employees who keep our world running – from baristas to nurses, cleaners to delivery drivers, florists to factory workers. Despite their vital role in society, most workplace technology has focused on those workers who sit behind a desk, but at Deputy, we transform the frontline. When businesses use Deputy, their workplaces thrive – the business is more profitable, compliant, and productive, while the workers are more engaged and happier at work.
We're becoming an AI-native company, a commitment that means you'll be empowered (and expected) to use AI tools and thinking in your day-to-day work. You'll have the training, support, and freedom to use AI responsibly and creatively to spark ideas, solve problems faster, and unlock new ways of working.
If you’re passionate about creating solutions that put people first and helping businesses and their teams thrive, join us at Deputy and make an impact where it matters most!

Role Overview

As a Senior Customer Success Manager (Senior CSM) at Deputy, you are the trusted strategic partner and customer advocate for a dedicated portfolio of high-value Mid-Market and Enterprise customers (typically accounts with 250+ to 1,000+ RTE). You engage during implementation by shadow-managing alongside Professional Services—ensuring seamless alignment, intervening proactively if roadblocks arise, and taking formal ownership at Go-Live. Across the customer lifecycle, you drive adoption, mitigate churn risk, lead strategic EBRs, and partner closely with Account Management to identify and qualify expansion opportunities.

This role will be joining our CSM team on a 12 month fixed term contract.

Key Responsibilities

    1. Implementation Partnership & Lifecycle Transition

  • Implementation Shadow-Management: Actively shadow-manage accounts during the onboarding and implementation phase alongside Professional Services to ensure early stakeholder alignment, validate configuration against business goals, and step in swiftly to mitigate risk if milestones or timelines stall.

  • Go-Live Handoff: Lead a frictionless transition from implementation to steady-state operations, ensuring zero loss of institutional context and delivering immediate continuity for customer admins and executives.

    • 2. Strategic Account Ownership & Relationship Management

  • Trusted Advisor: Build and nurture multi-threaded relationships across executive and operational leadership (HR, Operations, Payroll, and C-Suite).

  • Mutual Success Planning: Co-create, maintain, and execute customer-specific Mutual Success Plans aligned with strategic business objectives, operational workflows, and quantifiable ROI.

  • Executive Business Reviews (EBRs / QBRs): Prepare and facilitate high-impact business reviews to showcase delivered value, present adoption metrics, share product roadmap updates, and realign on executive priorities.

  • Customer Advocacy & Proof Points: Cultivate referenceable customer relationships, partnering with Marketing to produce case studies, customer quotes, reference calls, and review platform engagement (e.g., G2).

    • 3. Product Adoption, Enablement & Ecosystem Navigation

  • Drive Depth of Adoption: Monitor portfolio usage telemetry, guiding customers on best practices to deepen adoption of core and advanced modules (e.g., smart scheduling, award interpretation, timesheets, and payroll readiness).

  • Tech Ecosystem Alignment: Comfortably navigate and advise on enterprise software ecosystems, troubleshooting and guiding standard workflows involving HRIS, payroll, and POS integrations (e.g., ADP, BambooHR, Gusto, Xero).

  • Strategic Enablement: Conduct tailored consultative workshops and optimization sessions to help customers operationalize new product capabilities.

  • Internal Feedback Loop: Synthesize customer feedback, recurring friction points, and feature requests to champion customer needs with Product, Engineering, and Design.

    • 4. Retention & Proactive Risk Mitigation

  • Churn Prevention & Health Tracking: Continuously evaluate account health scores, platform telemetry (via Vitally/Salesforce), and support ticket trends to detect early indicators of risk or "silent churn."

  • Escalation Management: Act as the senior point of escalation for complex account issues, mobilizing Support, Professional Services, and Product teams to resolve critical blockers.

  • Renewal Partnership: Partner proactively with Account Managers (AMs) 90–120 days ahead of renewals, sharing usage health, relationship sentiment, and delivered ROI to ensure predictable, on-time contract renewals.

    • 5. Growth, Expansion & Commercial Partnership

  • Expansion Identification: Uncover organizational changes, new business units/locations, or unmet operational workflows suitable for add-on modules (e.g., Deputy HR, advanced compliance, payroll sync) or seat growth.

  • Pipeline Enablement: Scope and qualify expansion leads before passing them seamlessly to Account Managers to close commercial agreements.

    • 6. Team Leadership & Operational Excellence

  • Mentorship: Provide coaching, deal support, and onboarding guidance to Associate and Mid-level CSMs across the Customer Success organization.

  • Playbooks & Tooling: Contribute to internal CS best practices, standard operating procedures, EBR templates, and health check playbooks.

What You Bring (Qualifications)

  • Experience: 5 to 8+ years of B2B SaaS Customer Success or Strategic Account Management experience, with at least 2+ years managing Mid-Market or Enterprise accounts.

  • Ecosystem Acumen: Strong comfort understanding and navigating SaaS tech ecosystems, integration touchpoints (APIs, webhooks, SSO), and upstream/downstream data flows between operational tools and payroll/HR systems.

  • Executive Presence: Proven track record of leading high-stakes meetings, workshops, and EBRs with senior leadership (COO, VP HR, Head of Payroll).

  • Process & Tooling Fluency: Hands-on experience working with modern CS and CRM tech stacks (e.g., Salesforce, Vitally or Gainsight, Jira, Slack).

  • Problem-Solving Rigor: Demonstrated ability to step into complex or stalled customer situations, diagnose root causes, and align internal cross-functional resources to drive swift resolution.

  • Domain Knowledge: Direct background in Workforce Management (WFM), HR tech, payroll, or time-and-attendance platforms is strongly desired.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Net Dollar Retention (NDR) & Gross Retention Rate (GRR): Achieve portfolio retention targets (standard benchmark: ≥110% NDR / ≥95% Gross Retention).

  • Platform Utilization & Health: Maintain target health scores and active feature utilization across assigned accounts.

  • Executive Engagement: Execution rate and quality score for scheduled BRs and active Mutual Success Plans maintained in Vitally.

  • Customer Satisfaction: Achieve portfolio-level CSAT and stakeholder NPS targets (typically average stakeholder NPS 35+).

  • Expansion Pipeline Generated: Total qualified expansion pipeline (leads and seats/ARR) handed over to Account Management.

Work Environment & Travel

  • Work Model: Remote

  • Travel Requirements: 10% to 15% travel required for on-site Executive Business Reviews, high-priority customer workshops, and occasional company offsites.

Employee Perks

- Enjoy a flexible work policy (with a work-from-home stipend to set you up for success at home!)
- Own a piece of Deputy through our Employee Share Ownership Plan (ESOP)
- Take paid parental leave to support you and your family
- We’ll match your 401k contributions to help you save for the future
- Access mental health support with Spring Health
- Get comprehensive health benefits
- Use our commuter reimbursement program
- Take additional leave days — including 20 PTO days, study assistance, celebration days and volunteering
- Join our global working groups; focused on collaboration, belonging and connection
Deputy believes in equal opportunity and that inclusiveness and diversity promotes innovation. Our global team members are from a variety of cultures. And we welcome different perspective and skills.
